title: The Warmth of Other Suns
author: Isabel Wilkerson
summary: Isabel Wilkerson follows three Black Americans who left the Jim Crow South between the 1910s and 1970s, set within the larger Great Migration that reshaped Northern and Western cities.
readIf: you like narrative history built around real lives and want to understand a movement of millions.
skipIf: you want a quick, tightly argued overview rather than a long, detailed account.
